description: This source file defines a custom NSView subclass 'HoverChromeContainerView' which acts as a container with overlay chrome controls for a content view on macOS. It includes internal classes for drag and resize handles, overlay views, and UI components such as close buttons, managing mouse tracking, window resizing, and user interactions.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView
classes.description: A custom NSView that encapsulates a content view and an overlay chrome interface with interaction capabilities, including mouse tracking and close action.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasDragHandleView
classes.description: An NSView subclass that handles window dragging when clicked and dragged.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasResizeHandleView
classes.description: An NSView subclass that enables resizing of the window via mouse drag.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.CanvasChromeOverlayView
classes.description: An NSView subclass that acts as a chrome overlay, including a close button, drag and resize handles, and hit-test logic to manage mouse interactions.

classes.name: HoverChromeContainerView.PassthroughVisualEffectView
classes.description: An NSVisualEffectView subclass that passes through hit testing, allowing mouse events to pass to views beneath.

methods.name: updateTrackingAreas
methods.description: Updates mouse tracking areas to detect mouse enter and exit events.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Invoked when the close button is pressed, triggers the onClose callback.
